## Learning goals

This week, we will cover best practices for project organization,
documenting your project with Markdown files,
and the basics of the Unix shell.
We'll also spend a bit of time getting to know VS Code,
the text editor that you will spend a lot of time in during this course.
You will learn:

#### [**Project file organization**](./w2a_project-org.qmd) (Tuesday)

A number of best practices for research project...

- file organization
- file management
- documentation.

#### [**Markdown & VS Code**](./w2b_vscode-markdown.qmd) (Tuesday)

- How to use Markdown for documentation (and beyond).
- Get to know our text editor for the course, VS Code.

#### [**Unix shell basics**](./w2c_shell.qmd) (Thursday)

- What the Unix shell is and what you can do with it
- Why it can be beneficial to use a command-line interface in general,
  and the Unix shell specifically
- How Unix commands are stuctured
- How to navigate around your computer with Unix commands
